acceptance.description: hireember.logs paths, line writer, redaction, run log and attempt log files, unwritable folder
log URLs serve plain text, 404 for bad ids and paths, runs view and ticket page links, Log removed, API fields
usage module, collector, LLM client usage parsing, scoring/tailoring/applying wiring, Model and tokens table and API usage
key scan of tracked files and seeded database, scanner self-checks, .env ignored, .env.example not (already true, must stay true)
every FR/SAF/NFR ID mapped, exempt or known exception; no duplicates or unknown IDs; files and test names exist; parked-fixes entries
README setup section and sleep sentence; CONTRIBUTING Safety rules and docs/safety.md cover section 7 phrases and SAF-1..12
prune at 90 days (91 deleted, 89 kept, other files left), max_age_days, prune on run start (same file as AC-1 logs tests)

neighbouring behaviour that must not change: /api/runs and ticket API fields, empty runs page, run_log DB rows, LLM chat return type, attempt_log rows, runs and attempts continue when the log folder is unwritable
